hero.title: Do you want to become a Sliquid Retailer or Distributor?
hero.body: Complete the form below and a member of the Sliquid sales team will contact you shortly.

form.heading: Become a Retailer or Distributor
form.name: Name
form.storeLocator: Would you like to join our Store Locator?
form.mapAgree: I agree to the Sliquid MAP Policy below

errors.emailInvalid: A valid email address is required.
errors.brandsRequired: Please select at least one brand.
errors.mapRequired: You must agree to the Sliquid MAP Policy.
errors.sendFailed: Something went wrong sending your application. Please try again or email sales@sliquid.com directly.

thanks.title: Thank You for Applying!
thanks.body: We've received your application to become a Sliquid retailer or distributor. A member of our sales team will review your submission and contact you shortly.
thanks.questions: If you have any immediate questions, feel free to reach us at <email>sales@sliquid.com</email>.
